verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS suite like Google Workspace, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only REST APIs (Admin SDK Directory and Reports, Cloud Identity) and Apps Script, which is described as a web-based, low-code environment. These are developer building blocks and adjacent automation, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
